finding: AudioContext output timestamps and latency observations require an independent clock-integrity gate before they can support render-timeline claims. Monotonicity, future-timestamp plausibility, and bounded delta drift must be preserved separately from route binding and physical audibility.
design_implication: Render-timeline evidence should be normalized through evaluateAudioClockEvidence before being admitted into the composed deployment-bound audio evidence packet.
uncertainty: Default drift thresholds are conservative engineering defaults, not browser-specific normative limits.
No physical iPhone Safari runtime sample was collected in this slice.
Clock consistency does not prove route binding or physical audibility.
falsification_route: Capture repeated getOutputTimestamp samples on an immutable deployed build, compare AudioContext and performance-clock deltas, and reject the render-timeline layer if monotonicity or configured drift bounds fail.
